cwe_content.cwe: CWE-552,Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties

candidate.Reason: This method allows arbitrary servlet path inclusion without validation. An attacker with SCRIPT rights can access sensitive files like /WEB-INF/xwiki.cfg and /WEB-INF/xwiki.properties by passing these paths as the URL parameter.

This method allows invoking any servlet path without authorization checks. Users with SCRIPT right can access sensitive files like /WEB-INF/xwiki.cfg by passing the path directly, bypassing authorization mechanisms.

cwe_content.cwe: CWE-552,Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties

candidate.Reason: This method allows arbitrary servlet invocation without access control validation. Users with SCRIPT rights can access internal files like /WEB-INF/xwiki.cfg by passing the path as URL parameter, making sensitive configuration files accessible externally.

This method allows direct invocation of servlet URLs without authorization checks, enabling access to sensitive files like /WEB-INF/xwiki.cfg and /WEB-INF/xwiki.properties when called with SCRIPT rights but without proper path validation or authorization enforcement
